notes.title: oldTail - Important changes have been updated v1.221
notes.notes:
Hi. This is BK

Important changes have been updated
v1.221

1. Changed to 1st person view -> 3rd person view
(Better to play)

2. Two closed maps have been opened
(Now you can go here)

3. Fixed e-key not working

4. hp and stamina values are displayed on the UI

5. The main character's attack speed are a little faster

6. TEXT display is faster
(mouse right click closed)

7. Changed to Full Screen -> Borderless Window
(The visible view is the same, more flexible for handling exceptions)

8. Bug Fixes


v1.224
1. Enemy HP has been modified to be more visible
2. yes and no buttons remained in the game has been fixed.


Inconvenience or bug found
Please report on the forum

thank you :)

notes.title: oldTail - Soon, there is an important update patch
notes.notes:
oldTail

Soon, there is an important update patch

1. Changed game view from 1st person to 3rd person (much easier to play)
2. Stamina and HP are displayed as numbers
3. Bug fixes
4. Text is printed quickly, you can close it by right-clicking the mouse
5. Modify the main character's attack action to be faster
6. 2 maps that were blocked will be opened. ( 7 maps -> 9 maps )
7. The game price will be adjusted upwards.


thanks you :)
